verdict.rationale: Anytype's desktop client source is publicly visible on GitHub (anyproto/anytype-ts) with a gRPC API and AI agent extensibility, suggesting readable source code, but independent community evidence explicitly states the code is under a 'source-available license' rather than a true open-source/open license, and that some claimed 'e2e encryption' details don't match reality — a concrete contradiction of an open-license claim. Missing for 10: an OSI-approved open-source license confirmation, and no vendor documentation clarifying licensing terms to counter the community claim.
